task: Ahmad: bad model responses, timeouts, and fallback behavior

python.transport: httpx.MockTransport and ASGITransport; no network model requests
cases_added: Malformed model JSON returns a JSONDecodeError fallback
Missing choices returns a KeyError fallback
Empty choices returns an IndexError fallback
Null model content returns a TypeError fallback
HTTP read timeout returns a ReadTimeout fallback
Worker timeout cancels a hanging model request
A shorter job deadline cancels a hanging model request before the worker timeout
asserted_for_each_failure: HTTP 200 with matching request_id, source rule_fallback, explicit error and hold action
No invented parameters or evidence in the fallback
Active request count returns to zero
With capacity one, a subsequent request succeeds as a model decision

cases_added: Fallback for an agent with no accepted model decision
Fallback for an agent with an earlier accepted model decision
assertions: Fallback is accepted as a fallback action and recorded separately
Fallback does not increase world or agent model-decision counts, model coverage or rule-decision counts
Fallback does not refresh the last accepted model-decision time
Applying the same fallback result twice does not double-count it
The world advances and a later valid model decision applies with conserved accounting

connection_review.findings: Existing candidate-choice mapping, request identity and final engine validation meet the basic connection requirements. No additional connection implementation was needed.
